import CategoryTheory.Limits
import Fintype

open CategoryTheory.Limits

theorem lg_target (G : Type u) [Group G] [Finite G] : HasColimitsOfShape (SingleObj G) FintypeCat := by
  let C := FintypeCat
  let J := SingleObj G
  have h_fintype_cocomplete : HasFiniteColimits C :=
    fintype_has_finite_colimits
  exact hasColimitsOfShape_of_hasFiniteColimits C J h_fintype_cocomplete
